title: Mapster
description: A fast, source-generated object mapper for .NET with zero runtime overhead.

data.text: Mapster is a fast object mapper that uses source generators to create mapping code at compile time. This eliminates reflection overhead and provides excellent performance compared to runtime mappers.

data.title: Installation
data.content: Install Mapster and the source generator.
data.code:
dotnet add package Mapster
dotnet add package Mapster.DependencyInjection

data.title: Using Mapster

terms.definition: A Roslyn feature that generates code at compile time.
The Mapster method that performs object mapping.

data.title: Performance
data.text: Mapster's source-generated mappers are as fast as hand-written mapping code.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Mapster uses source generators for compile-time mapping
data.takeaway: Mapster is ideal when you need high-performance object mapping without runtime costs.

data.title: Exercise
data.expectedOutcome: A mapped destination object using source-generated code.
